description: Training hyperparameters of the published Learned-CFA and Static-CFA policies (Table 3 of the paper): the values below are the ones the released policies were trained with. The hyperparameter search can be re-run with NN_Optimization = 'y' in MainScript.py, which writes its own selection to results/NN_Size/best_hyperparameters.json; that selection need not coincide with these values, which were fixed by hand for the final runs.
